00 · Start here
A growth breakdown for Caddy
Why we made this

Your 19 October post put Caddy in the shopping aisle: spot something you like out and about, text it, and Caddy finds it. Rajiv added that it finds the best deal and the coupon codes too, and since 25 September paying takes one click with Stripe Link. That is a whole purchase in one text thread, and it is something a creator can film in ten seconds.

This board is how we would put that moment in front of holiday shoppers and busy 9 to 5ers before Black Friday on 27 November. It is free, so take whatever is useful.

How to read this board
Use the list on the left, or press P to go frame by frame. On a phone, just scroll.
Creator cards: platform, followers and median views on recent videos.
Please note
Made by hypjam from public information, checked 26 Oct 2026. Nobody at Caddy asked for this, and it is not paid work. The creators named here have not been contacted and have no link to hypjam: they show the kind of people we would cast.
12 creators shortlisted, 4 scripts with 32 hooks, and a plan to show Caddy shopping, planning and replying by text before the holiday rush.
Four numbers to remember
130%: the rise Adobe expects in AI traffic to US retail sites this holiday season
3: ways to text Caddy: iMessage, RCS and, since your 16 October app update, WhatsApp
1 click: to pay for what Caddy finds, with Stripe Link
32: hooks written across 4 scripts
Who made this

hypjam is a UGC agency in London. We cast, script, direct and edit creators for consumer startups, and run the best videos as ads.

01 · Why UGC
Why creator videos work
Authenticity
People trust people
"Caddy can find it" is a claim. A creator texting a photo of a lamp from a shop window and buying it two taps later is proof.
Show, do not tell
The texts are the demo
Caddy lives in Messages, so the product is a screen everyone already knows. Blue bubbles on camera explain it in two seconds.
Objections
Answer "will it act without me?" out loud
A real person tapping approve before every order, email and invite answers it before anyone asks.
A real deadline
Black Friday is 27 November
The biggest shopping week of the year lands inside your first month. Creators finding gifts by text give people a reason to start now.
Fuel for ads
Your best ads come from creators
Videos that already work on TikTok can run as Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads, with 8 openings per script, so the budget follows what people actually watch.
Doesn't feel like an ad
Looks like a normal post
So people actually watch it instead of scrolling past. It is still labelled as an ad, it just does not feel like one.
02 · What we learned
Where Caddy is today
The product
A Personal AI you text. It lives in iMessage on iPhone, RCS on Android and, since version 2.0 on 16 October, WhatsApp. Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Linear or your task app, and Caddy sends a daily brief, texts first when something needs you, writes the replies you approve and works through websites: carts, bookings and airline check-in.
The offer
Free to start, in public beta, for adults 18 and over. The Caddy app is free on the App Store, and payments inside Caddy take one click with Stripe Link. Caddy asks before it sends an email or invitation and before it places an order.
Your own channels
@try_caddy on X: 14.8K views on your NYC film (27 Aug), 8.0K on the app launch (26 Sep) and 4.0K on Stripe Link checkout (25 Sep). Rajiv's interactive iMessage demo: 7.9K (23 Sep). Each one is a short video of the product working.
Already in motion
  • Shopping (19 Oct): spot it, text it, Caddy finds it, plus the best deal and coupon codes.
  • A full interface inside the iMessage thread, with one-tap email replies (12 Oct).
  • A Plaid partnership for spending, subscriptions and free-trial reminders (15 Sep).
  • TechCrunch features Caddy in its running list of AI agents that live in your texts.
What that tells us
Every feature you ship is a moment someone can film: a photo in, a product found, a reply sent with one tap. Your launch videos show it well. What is missing is volume: real people showing Caddy inside their own week, every week.
The timing
Adobe expects US shoppers to spend $275.1 billion online from 1 November to 31 December, with AI traffic to retail sites up 130% on last year and the biggest jump on Thanksgiving. This is the season more shoppers try an AI.
Sources: caddy.app and its use case pages, Caddy's terms, the YC company page, the App Store listing (version 2.0, 16 Oct), posts by @try_caddy, @ConnorWaslo and @sanchetio on X, TechCrunch (24 Oct 2026) and Adobe (28 Sep 2026), all read 26 Oct 2026.

TechCrunch now keeps a running list of AI agents you can simply text. Its 24 October edition names 24 of them, Caddy among them.

Shoppers

The opening for Caddy

Sources: TechCrunch, "Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages" (24 Oct 2026); TikTok search for #tabpartner and the reference videos in frame 09, all read 26 Oct 2026.
04 · The objection
Inbox and card: the objection to win
Everyone's first question about an assistant with their inbox and their card is the same: what does it do without me? Your answer is a good one, and it belongs on camera.
What you already promise
  • Caddy asks before sending emails or invitations and before placing orders
  • It cannot read your other iMessage conversations
  • In a group chat it only sees that thread, never your connected apps
  • You connect only the apps you choose
How we use it
Every script keeps the approval in the edit: "Want me to send it?", the checkout review, the booking that waits for a yes. Viewers see a person in control in every video.
Show it as it happened
Creators film the thread on their own phone, exactly as it happened, with nothing mocked up. Real threads are what make the results believable.
Privacy on screen
Names, email addresses, phone numbers, order numbers and card details are blurred. Friends in a group chat agree before anyone films, and nobody is photographed without asking.
What creators never say
No "it does everything", no promise of the lowest price anywhere, and nothing your site and your own posts do not say Caddy does.
Sources: caddy.app FAQ and the AI in iMessage and group chat pages, read 26 Oct 2026.
05 · Audience
Who to sell to first
Start here
Holiday shoppers
Spot it, text it, Caddy finds it, one click to pay. Shopping is your newest feature, and November is its biggest month. Format A.
Start here
Busy 9 to 5ers in big cities
Inbox, calendar and Slack all day. The daily brief and one-tap replies are made for them, and NYC is your home turf. Format B.
Broadest reach
Friend groups and roommates
Friendsgiving, Secret Santa, the group trip. Caddy in the group chat keeps track of who brings what, and every friend in the thread sees it work. Format C.
Saves
People flying home for the holidays
A fare watch with a target price, a text when it moves, and a booking that waits for a yes. Format D.
Where we would start
Holiday shoppers and busy 9 to 5ers first. Shopping is what you are pushing now and the next five weeks are its peak, while the 9 to 5 crowd already lives in Gmail, Calendar and Slack, so Caddy is useful to them from the first text.

Thanksgiving to Cyber Monday

December

What this needs from you
  • A Caddy account for each creator, with shopping and Stripe Link checkout working on their own phone

Why start now
Adobe expects $95.8 billion in online spending in October alone, before the season even starts. Videos made in early November are tested and cut by Black Friday.

Your first four weeks

You approve the shortlist and the 4 formats. We sign creators and send each one a script with 8 hooks. They start texting Caddy every day, so what shows on screen is really theirs.

First videos come in, and we review each within 48 hours. Shopping and 9 to 5 videos first.
Week 3 · 16-22 Nov
First videos go live, plus the Friendsgiving group chats. The best openings start as TikTok Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads, each with its creator's own link.
Week 4 · 23-29 Nov
Thanksgiving and Black Friday week: budget on the winning shopping hooks, then a results review together: sign-ups by creator and by ad, and the plan for December.
If it is a yes this week
Agreement signed and creators texting Caddy by Friday. First videos live within 14 days of the scripts being signed off.

Takeaway

10 · Script A
Script A: Spot it, text it
The brief

Where: TikTok and Instagram Reels, then TikTok Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads to caddy.app (15s and 30s cuts)

Length: 30-35s master. 15s cut: shots 1, 3, 4 and 6 (hook, the photo sent, what Caddy found, the one-tap checkout).

Goal: Sign-ups at caddy.app during the holiday shopping weeks

Who films it: A US shopping or style creator, 18+, who has used Caddy on their own phone for a week. The item is something they really want: in a shop window, at a market, or a friend's jacket with the friend's OK on camera. No strangers photographed. Shot handheld: outside first, then at home.

8 hooks to test (on screen, then spoken)
  1. I texted a photo of a [lamp] and my AI found itI texted a photo of a [lamp] I saw in a window, and my AI found it.
  2. Saw it. Texted it. Found it.Saw it, texted it, found it. Watch.
  3. POV: you spot the perfect [jacket] and have no idea where it's fromYou know when you spot the perfect [jacket] and have no idea where it's from?
  4. My holiday shopping happens in my texts nowMy holiday shopping happens in my texts this year.
  5. I don't search for gifts anymore. I text a photo.I don't search for gifts anymore. I just text a photo.
  6. Asked my friend where her [bag] is from. Texted Caddy instead.I was going to ask my friend where her [bag] is from. I texted Caddy instead. [only with the friend's OK on camera]
  7. Finding this [coat] took one textFinding this [coat] took one text. Here's the text.
  8. My gift list is a text thread nowMy gift list is just a text thread now. Let me show you.

Rules for this video

FTC: 'Ad | Paid partnership with Caddy' on screen from 0s to the end, said by 0:05, the platform's paid-partnership label on, and the caption opens with the disclosure. The thread is shown exactly as it happened: never mock up or edit a reply, a price, a code or a checkout. Prices and codes only as they were on the day, and no "cheapest anywhere" or savings claims beyond what is on screen. The purchase is the creator's own and is approved on camera. Blur card numbers, addresses and order numbers. Nobody is photographed without asking; a friend's item only with their OK on camera; adults only. No claims beyond caddy.app and Caddy's own posts.

Why it should convert
It shows the newest thing Caddy does in under 30 seconds, from a real moment outside to one tap at checkout, which is the exact shape of a holiday shopping ad. The found item is the payoff, and the approval tap answers the trust question in the same shot.

14-20sDays later, date on screen: the real update arrives. If the fare dropped, the drop. If not, the baseline and the watch still running.[the real update, dated][Say exactly what happened.]
20-26sOnly if booking: Caddy checks before paying, and the approval stays on screen.Caddy checks with me before paying[Only if you booked, in your words.]
26-30sCreator to camera.caddy.app | save this for your holiday flightsIt's called Caddy. One text and it watches the fare for you. Link's in my bio.
Product moment and call to action

The watch text is on screen by 0:05 and Caddy is named at 0:03. Hero moment 0:14-0:20: Caddy texts first with the real fare update, then books only after a yes.

CTA: Get started for free at caddy.app through the creator's own link and set a fare watch by text.

Caption
Ad | Paid partnership with @try_caddy. I texted Caddy my route, dates and price, and [what happened, one line, your words]. Save this for your holiday flights. #ad #caddy #cheapflights #thanksgivingtravel
Rules for this video

FTC: 'Ad | Paid partnership with Caddy' on screen from 0s, said by 0:05, the platform's paid-partnership label on, and the caption opens with the disclosure. Real fares and dates only: never fake or stage a price drop, and if the fare did not move, say so. Caddy's page says these are scheduled checks, so a fare can change between checks; no promise of the lowest fare or of any saving. Caddy checks before paying, and the approval stays in the edit. Blur booking references, names and payment details. No claims beyond caddy.app and Caddy's own posts.

Why it should convert
A fare watch by text is easy to understand and worth saving before holiday travel. It also shows the part of Caddy people do not expect from an assistant: it texts you first when something changes.

16 · Ads
How the paid ads would run
1 · Film
Each script is shot once, with 8 different openings.
→
2 · Launch
Each opening runs as its own ad, from the creator's handle as a partnership ad.
→
3 · Read
After a few days we compare cost per sign-up and how many people watch past 3 seconds.
4 · Cut
The weakest openings switch off and the budget moves to the best two.
→
5 · Remix
Winning hooks get new bodies and new creators.
→
6 · Refresh
New creator videos every week, so the ads never go stale.
Where the ads point
Caddy's sign-up at caddy.app, through one link per creator, so every sign-up traces back to the video that drove it. The same videos run as TikTok Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads.
Why partnership ads
Ads that run from a creator's own handle look like that creator's post, not a brand ad. That is the format these videos are built for.
What we would need
Access to your TikTok and Meta ad accounts (or we run them from ours), sign-ups by link, and a weekly look at the numbers.
17 · Process
How a campaign runs, step by step
1 · Brief
You tell us the goal, the audience and what can and can't be said about Caddy.
→
2 · Cast
We shortlist creators by niche, location and median views. You pick.
→
3 · Offer
We send each creator the brief, the dates and the rate.
4 · Sign
A written agreement with every creator, covering usage and disclosure.
→
5 · Scripts
One per format: 8 hooks, a shot list, screens to record and a caption.
→
6 · Film and upload
Creators film on their phones and upload to a private folder only we see.
7 · Review
We check every video within 48 hours. Nothing posts unapproved.
→
8 · Post
On the creator's own account, with the ad disclosure and the paid-partnership label.
→
9 · Pay and report
Creators paid within 7 days of going live. You get a report every Monday.
Where creators talk to us
One hypjam Discord for every creator. Each campaign gets a private channel group for chat, scripts and posted links that only its creators and your team can see.
Accounts
Each signed creator sets up their own Caddy and uses it every day for a week before filming, so the brief, the replies and the finds on screen are really theirs.
18 · Reporting
What we report, and when
Every video
Views, how many people stay past 3 seconds, average watch time, saves, shares and comments.
Every creator link
A tracking link for each creator, so sign-ups trace back to the video that drove them.
Every Monday
A short report: every video, the hooks that won, sign-ups by creator, and what we change next.
Every month
A review call: spend, sign-ups, cost per result on anything run as an ad, and the plan for next month.
19 · Rules
Rules we never break
Disclosure
"Ad | Paid partnership with Caddy" on screen, said in the first seconds, and the platform's paid-partnership label on. That is what the FTC asks for.
Who films
Adults only (18+). Creators use Caddy themselves before they talk about it.
What gets said
Nothing your own pages do not say Caddy does. No invented numbers. We never pay for a positive opinion, only for the video.
Approval on camera
Every order, email and invite in a video is approved on camera, the way Caddy asks for it. Nothing is mocked up, and nothing is shown that Caddy did not do.
People on screen
Friends in a group chat are adults who agree before anyone films. Other people's names, numbers, emails and card details are blurred, and nobody is photographed without asking.
How we run it
Every video reviewed within 48 hours before it posts. Creators paid within 7 days of going live.
